title: 濃縮開場：賺錢的樂園為何要賣

data.prompt: Wide shot in a modest Billund office in autumn 2004, one generic adult analyst slides a blank folder beside four small park models on a table, a concerned face turned toward the models, soft overcast window light from the left

lines.text: 二〇〇四年秋天，丹麥比隆。樂高把自己的四座樂園，列入出售計畫。

data.prompt: Close-up at the same office desk in 2004, one generic adult analyst lifts the corner of a blank ledger page beside a small park model, a puzzled face visible above the page, mild desk-lamp light from the left

lines.text: 但那一年的年報，樂園那一欄還記著獲利。賺錢的生意，為什麼也得放手？

data.prompt: Medium close-up at a transaction study desk, one generic researcher slides two separate blank company folders into different document trays, focused face above the desk, mild overhead light

lines.text: 隔年七月，這四座樂園進入一筆跨國交易。新的股權表，會留下誰？

data.prompt: Close-up at the ledger desk, one generic researcher opens the bookmarked page with a single finger, intent face above the blank page, soft lamp light from the left

lines.text: 到了年底，集團的損益出現轉變；把年報翻開，轉變又從哪裡來？

data.prompt: Medium close-up at a family-investment records desk in 2019, one generic archivist opens a plain portfolio binder beside a simple toy model and a park model, attentive expression, soft desk-lamp light

lines.text: 十四年後，創辦家族的投資公司，再次出現在樂園經營者的買方名單。那算買回來了嗎？

data.prompt: Medium shot back at the Billund office table, one generic adult analyst holds a single unmarked toy brick above a plain tray, four park models rest farther along the table, questioning expression, mild window light

lines.text: 一家靠積木長大的公司，究竟少了什麼，才得賣掉自己打造的樂園？
